title: What a bug check says
description:
Decode the codes from a blue screen.

```
0x0000000A IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL
  p1 0x0000000000000000  address referenced
  p2 0x0000000000000002  IRQL at the time (DISPATCH_LEVEL)
0x00000050 PAGE_FAULT_IN_NONPAGED_AREA
0x000000C4 DRIVER_VERIFIER_DETECTED_VIOLATION
```
hints: `!analyze -v` in WinDbg prints the same information from a crash dump (lesson 1.05).
requirements: A table of at least six common bug check codes with names and what their parameters mean.
Print the IRQL parameter as a name (0 PASSIVE, 1 APC, 2 DISPATCH).
Unknown codes print `look it up in the Bug Check Code Reference`.
stretch: Read a list of codes from a text file of past crashes and count each kind.
